live_events.author: LeonMalisov
live_events.text:
Six migrants, an infant among them, have died off the Greek island of Lesvos, after their speedboat from Turkey collided with a coast guard vessel during a chase in the dark and capsized. Eight were rescued. #Lesvos #Greece #Migrants
